metadata.title: Success Cases
metadata.description: Real client engagements with measurable outcomes — from a $100k Tealium migration at Abercrombie & Fitch to a 15% lead gen lift at K12.

blocks.heading: Real clients. Real constraints. Measurable results.
blocks.subtext: Six years of enterprise analytics and frontend engagements across retail, education, travel, and e-commerce — from Abercrombie & Fitch to Toyota.

items.title: Segment → Tealium Migration — Abercrombie & Fitch
items.summary: The global clothing retailer needed to migrate their entire analytics data collection infrastructure from Segment to Tealium across multiple code repositories. I led the end-to-end migration, architecting a standardized tracking framework and automated governance system — delivered 2 months ahead of schedule.

items.title: End-to-End ETL & Data Governance — Buendia Tours
items.summary: A Spanish travel agency needed full marketing attribution visibility across their digital properties. I orchestrated a complete ETL pipeline — Website → GTM → GA4 → BigQuery — enabling real-time marketing attribution dashboards and full GDPR consent compliance.

items.title: CRO & Enrollment Funnel Tracking — K12
items.summary: K12, a US online education company, needed to boost lead generation and gain accurate visibility into their enrollment funnel. I designed A/B tests in Adobe Target and refined the data collection pipeline, achieving a 15% increase in lead generation.

items.title: Server-Side Tagging Implementation — Farmatodo
items.summary: The Colombian drugstore chain was losing conversion signal data to ad-blockers. I pioneered a server-side tagging architecture using GTM, integrated the full marketing stack, and built real-time dashboards connecting BigQuery to Looker for C-suite reporting.

blocks.headline: Have a challenge that fits this profile?
blocks.subtext: I take on a limited number of engagements at a time to ensure every client gets my full attention. If your project is a good fit, let's find out.
